# CrossWorldService

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- A **service**: get it with `game:GetService("CrossWorldService")`
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`

Sends a game's events between its worlds: a guild's chat, a world boss that appears for everyone, an operator's announcement. A world publishes on a topic, and every world that subscribes to it hears it, the publisher included, in the order the manager received them.

Under a manager (`servers.toml`) a message crosses worlds; a world on its own hears its own, so the same code runs tested on one machine. Delivery is at most once and not guaranteed: a world that is restarting misses what was published meanwhile, and a message older than 10 seconds when its turn comes is dropped. Never movement and never a part: what crosses is an event, and the world it lands in decides what it does. Server side only.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Methods

### `Publish(topic: string, message: any)`

Sends `message` to every world subscribed to `topic`. The message is anything `SaveService` can store, at most 4 KiB written, and the topic at most 80 bytes. A world may publish 200 messages a second; past that this raises.

### `Subscribe(topic: string, callback: (message: any, origin: string) -> ())`

Calls `callback` with each message published on `topic`, and the name of the world that published it. That name is empty for this world when no manager runs it. A world may subscribe to 1000 topics. Each call runs on a thread of its own, between ticks.

### `Unsubscribe(topic: string)`

Stops every callback this world gave for `topic`.
